column1: # mapping_set_title: Plant engineering: CFIHOS 2.0 and DEXPI 2.0.1

column9: A CFIHOS company is any legal entity in the handover, the owner and operator as well as contractors, manufacturers and suppliers; a DEXPI enterprise is the ISA-95 enterprise at the top of the plant breakdown, i.e. the owner or operator. The enterprise is the narrower of the two.
A property cfihos:Company and dexpi:Enterprise share.
Both are the geographical site a plant stands on; DEXPI defines it as ISA-95 does.
A property cfihos:Site and dexpi:Site share.
A property cfihos:Site and dexpi:Site share.

Both are the assembly of equipment performing a process, the root of the plant's functional breakdown: a CFIHOS plant decomposes into process units and tags, a DEXPI process plant into plant sections, systems and trains.
A property cfihos:Plant and dexpi:ProcessPlant share.
A property cfihos:Plant and dexpi:ProcessPlant share.
A CFIHOS process unit is the process engineer's breakdown of a plant into sub-functions; a DEXPI plant section, defined by ISO 10209, is the same level of the breakdown.
A property cfihos:ProcessUnit and dexpi:PlantSection share.
A property cfihos:ProcessUnit and dexpi:PlantSection share.
Both are the physical area of a plant an item stands in; DEXPI defines it as ISA-95 does.
A property cfihos:Area and dexpi:PlantArea share.
A property cfihos:Area and dexpi:PlantArea share.

A CFIHOS tag is the specification of a function in the plant that equipment fulfils; a DEXPI tagged plant item is the same function as drawn on a P&ID. The tag name joins them. CFIHOS keeps the tag apart from the serialised equipment installed against it, which a P&ID doesn't show.
A property cfihos:Tag and dexpi:TaggedPlantItem share.

CFIHOS tags a pump's driver on its own, e.g. PM-2001A, with the pump as its parent tag; DEXPI draws the motor as a component of the pump, named by a sub-tag. The two describe the same motor, but share no identifier.
